meta.name: Love Story
meta.description: Serie de antología de apasionantes historias de amor verdadero que captaron la atención del mundo.

videos.title: Piloto
videos.overview: El apellido Kennedy pesa sobre John. Carolyn brilla en Calvin Klein. Surge una conexión inesperada.

videos.title: La fiesta Pools
videos.overview: John hace malabares entre su madre, Daryl y los nuevos sentimientos que tiene por Carolyn.

videos.title: La viuda de Estados Unidos
videos.overview: Tras una tragedia familiar, John busca consuelo en Carolyn.

videos.title: Te amo
videos.overview: A Carolyn le cuesta encajar en el mundo de John. Él descubre un secreto.

videos.title: Battery Park
videos.overview: John asks an important question. Carolyn and John publicly feud.

videos.title: The Wedding
videos.overview: As press spreads of their altercation, John and Carolyn prepare for their big day. Ann voices her concerns.

videos.title: Obsession
videos.overview: Carolyn suffers the consequences of being a public figure; tensions rise between Carolyn and John's family.

videos.title: Exit Strategy
videos.overview: Tensions boil over after John and Carolyn discover devastating news.

videos.title: Search and Recovery
videos.overview: John and Carolyn fight to keep their relationship intact; the world watches as tragedy strikes.

videos.title: A Love Untold - First Look
videos.overview: In this YouTube video, go behind the scenes for a first look at FX’s Love Story: John F. Kennedy Jr. & Carolyn Bessette.

videos.title: A Love Untold - The Carolyn Effect
videos.overview: Confident. Chic. Trendsetting. In this YouTube video, dive into the world of beauty and fashion with a behind-the-scenes look at the process of capturing the iconic style of Carolyn Bessette.

videos.title: A Love Untold - On-Set with Sarah Pidgeon
videos.overview: In this YouTube video, go behind the scenes with Sarah Pidgeon and the team that shaped her character’s signature style.

videos.title: Episode 1: Sarah Pidgeon and Paul Anthony Kelly | Love Story: JFK Jr. & Carolyn Official Podcast
videos.overview: Evan Ross Katz goes behind the scenes with Sarah Pidgeon and Paul Anthony Kelly to discuss portraying iconic characters and their chemistry on set in the complex and heartbreaking journey of a couple whose private love became a national obsession.

videos.title: Episode 2: Naomi Watts and Connor Hines | Love Story: JFK Jr. & Carolyn Official Podcast
videos.overview: Naomi Watts talks with Evan Ross Katz about portraying the character of Jackie Kennedy Onassis and creator, executive producer, and writer Connor Hines discusses what drew him to the series.

videos.title: Episode 3: Alex DiGerlando | Love Story: JFK Jr. & Carolyn Official Podcast
videos.overview: Evan Ross Katz interviews Production Designer Alex DiGerlando as he reveals how the minimalist aesthetic of the 1990s was used to highlight the characters and guided set choices.

videos.title: Episode 4: Rudy Mance | Love Story: JFK Jr. & Carolyn Official Podcast
videos.overview: Evan Ross Katz sits down with Costume Designer Rudy Mance to dive into the intricate details of dressing the character of Carolyn and the cast from the research to sourcing pieces and the meticulous alterations for the perfect fit.

videos.title: Episode 5: Grace Gummer | Love Story: JFK Jr. & Carolyn Official Podcast
videos.overview: Evan Ross Katz talks to Grace Gummer about her role as the character of Caroline Kennedy, her preparation for it, her on-screen dynamic with Paul Anthony Kelly as the character of John F. Kennedy Jr. and working with Naomi Watts.

videos.title: A Love Untold - Love Story Leads
videos.overview: Chemistry that ignites a creative spark. Explore the dynamic connection between Sarah Pidgeon and Paul Anthony Kelly as their characters fall in love on our screens.

videos.title: A Love Untold - The Wedding
videos.overview: True elegance in every detail. Go behind-the-scenes with the creative team that brought one of the most iconic weddings to life.

videos.title: A Love Untold - Getting Into Character
videos.overview: Get an inside look at the meticulous process of curating the timeless and complex cast of FX’s Love Story.

videos.title: A Love Untold - In Vogue
videos.overview: Recreating a New York City era like no other. Immerse yourself in the nostalgia of the 90s and discover how the creative team captured the attitude, style and grit of 90’s NY.
